description: This Java class defines the configuration options for MongoDB, specifically handling options such as SSL enablement and read preference. It encapsulates the logic for loading configuration settings with fallback and provides methods to access these options.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates MongoDB options such as SSL enablement and read preference, loaded from a configuration source.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultOptionsConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: isSslEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SSL is enabled for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: readPreference
methods.description: Returns the read preference setting for MongoDB.
